protocols.title: Severe Bleeding
steps: Call 112 immediately
Apply firm, direct pressure with clean cloth or bandage
Do not remove cloth — add more on top if soaked
Keep pressure for at least 10 minutes
Elevate injured limb above heart level if possible
Do NOT apply tourniquet unless bleeding is life-threatening

protocols.title: Fracture / Broken Bone
steps: Do not attempt to straighten the bone
Immobilize using splint (use magazines, cardboard)
Apply ice wrapped in cloth to reduce swelling
Keep the victim still and comfortable
Monitor for signs of shock (pale, cold, confused)
Wait for medical help

protocols.title: Head Injury
steps: Call emergency services immediately
Keep victim awake and talking
Do not remove helmet if worn
If unconscious, place in recovery position (unless spinal injury suspected)
Watch for: unequal pupils, confusion, vomiting
Do NOT give food, water, or medication

protocols.title: Suspected Spinal Injury
steps: Do NOT move the victim — this is critical
Call emergency services immediately
Keep head, neck, and spine aligned
If victim must be moved (fire/water), use multiple people to move as one unit
Keep victim warm and conscious
Document how accident happened for medics

protocols.title: Vehicle Fire
steps: Get everyone away from vehicle immediately (minimum 30 meters)
Call fire services: 101 (India)
Do NOT return to burning vehicle for any reason
If victim clothing is on fire: Stop, Drop, Roll
Move to upwind side of vehicle
Warn passing traffic to slow down
